# PRD v1 — apiary

**Layer 4 — Intent.** Immutable once written. Requirements change by writing the next version,
**PRD-v2.md**, and never by editing this file.

*Version 1 · 2026-01-01 · active*

## Purpose

Tracks which beehive colonies in an apiary are queenless, so one beekeeper can plan a week of
inspections.

## Open questions

- **Open question:** whether inspections need to work offline.
